script: Days on Earth are slowly getting longer. The Moon's gravity acts like a brake on Earth's spin. Each century, a day gets about two milliseconds longer. When the last dinosaurs lived, a day was about half an hour shorter than today. Hundreds of millions of years ago, a year had more than 400 days.
